  • Method Details

    • parseWhere

      public static SqlBuilder.Where parseWhere(Map<String,?> where, Dialect dialect, Map<String,Object> params, String prefix)
      Builds the WHERE clause for a filter tree.

      Every value reaches the database as a bind parameter; no value is ever formatted into the SQL. AND/OR/NOT groups are supported, and an empty in: [] becomes 1=0 rather than invalid IN () SQL.

    • buildOrderBy

    • appendUpdateSet

      public static void appendUpdateSet(List<String> setParts, List<Object> values, String column, Object value, Dialect dialect)
      Appends one SET assignment, expanding the arithmetic update operators.

    • quoteTable

      public static String quoteTable(String table, Dialect dialect)
      Quotes a possibly schema-qualified table name.

      An already-bracketed name is never returned as-is: that quoting is only correct on MSSQL, so the brackets are stripped and re-applied for the target dialect instead of letting one dialect's quoting follow the name into another.

    • sanitizeParamName

      public static String sanitizeParamName(String name)
      A bind parameter name that is a legal identifier in every dialect.
